executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across multiple test classes. The primary issues are type mismatches (long vs UUID/String, Priority vs TaskPriority), missing methods in data store implementations, and incorrect method signatures in service interfaces. These errors indicate a significant refactoring or API change that broke the test suite.

errors.root_cause: The GlobalExceptionHandler class no longer has a handleValidationErrors method, but tests are still calling it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update GlobalExceptionHandlerTest to use the correct method name or signature that replaced handleValidationErrors, or restore the method if it was removed in error.

errors.message: Multiple type conversion errors: long cannot be converted to String/UUID, Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: The Task entity and related DTOs changed their ID type from long to UUID and Priority enum was renamed to TaskPriority, but tests still use old types.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test data creation to use UUID.randomUUID() instead of long IDs, and use TaskPriority enum instead of Priority throughout InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method findAll(), existsById(), saveAll()
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore interface or implementation removed these methods but tests still reference them.
errors.fix_recommendation: Either restore findAll(), existsById(UUID), and saveAll(List<Task>) methods to InMemoryTaskDataStore, or update tests to use alternative methods that provide the same functionality.

errors.message: Constructor Task cannot be applied to given types
errors.root_cause: Task entity constructor signature changed but tests still use old constructor with positional parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskTest to use builder pattern or new constructor signature. Replace direct constructor calls with Task.builder().id(uuid).title(title)...build() pattern.

errors.message: Method signatures mismatch: createTask, getUserTasks, getTaskById, updateTask, deleteTask require different parameters
errors.root_cause: TaskService interface methods now require userId (String) as first parameter, but tests call them without it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all TaskServiceImplTest method calls to include userId as first parameter. For example: createTask(userId, request) instead of createTask(request), getTaskById(taskId, userId) instead of getTaskById(taskId).

errors.message: Method findByUserId requires 4 parameters but only 3 provided
errors.root_cause: findByUserId method signature changed to require sortBy parameter but tests don't provide it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add sortBy parameter (String) to all findByUserId calls in tests. Example: findByUserId(userId, page, size,

errors.message: Bad operand types for binary operator '+': UUID + int
errors.root_cause: Test code attempts to concatenate UUID with integer, which is not supported.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace UUID arithmetic with proper UUID generation. Use UUID.randomUUID() for each new task instead of trying to increment UUIDs.

errors.message: @MockBean is deprecated and marked for removal
errors.root_cause: Spring Boot deprecated @MockBean in favor of newer testing annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace @MockBean with @MockitoBean from org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito package, or use @Mock with @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class).
